source_pointer_scope: Each JSON Pointer is relative to the individual task object in its tasks.json file.

rubric_convention.required_slots: Every required slot must be answered semantically; verbatim wording is not required.
rubric_convention.optional_slots: Omission is allowed, but any asserted optional fact must be correct.
rubric_convention.extra_claims: Any other material factual claim must be supported by the user request and accepted tool results.

required_slots.name: connection_verdict
required_slots.description: State that staying through the 4:50 PM curtain call cannot meet the concert's 5:50 PM completed-entry deadline.

required_slots.name: latest_departure_and_early_minutes
required_slots.description: State that the three transfer components total 75 minutes, requiring departure by 4:35 PM, which is 15 minutes before the matinee ends.

required_slots.name: total_credit
required_slots.description: State that the attendee should receive 1,600 TWD in total credit.

required_slots.name: daily_breakdown
required_slots.description: Explain that Friday earns zero, Saturday earns 600 TWD because 4 of 10 hours is below 50 percent and receives half of 1,200 TWD, and Sunday earns 1,000 TWD for cancellation before opening.

required_slots.name: headliner_view
required_slots.description: State that the headliner faces east and the East Lower seat has a clear view in that orientation.

required_slots.name: clear_set_count
required_slots.description: State that exactly three of the five sets have a completely clear view.

required_slots.name: applicable_delay_tier
required_slots.description: State that the game started 95 minutes late and therefore falls in the 60-to-119-minute tier paying 25 percent of face value.

required_slots.name: credit_amount
required_slots.description: State that 25 percent of the 1,800 TWD face value is 450 TWD and remains below the 500 TWD cap, so the credit is 450 TWD.

required_slots.name: earliest_eligible_round_and_limit
required_slots.description: State that Early Gold is the earliest eligible draw but permits at most two Saturday tickets in one application.

required_slots.name: required_round_for_three_together
required_slots.description: State that three tickets together require waiting for the General member draw on September 13, which permits up to four, because applications cannot be split across rounds.
